description: An alias expression names the projection.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS n $$) AS ("n" agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name AS "n"))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name AS "n"))
